def access.modify_allow_operation
  (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (entries : Slice Entry) :
  Result (core.result.Result Bool OperationError)
  := do
  let related_acp ← access.modify_related_acp ctl me.ident
  let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref related_acp
  let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref me.modlist
  let b ← access.modify_all_entries ctl me.ident s entries s1
  ok (core.result.Result.Ok b)

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel kanidm_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace kanidm_kernel.Solution

/-- `i5h_invert`, also through the `uncurry` of tuple-destructuring binds. -/
macro "inv " h:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  repeat' (first
    | (simp only [I5hLib.bind_tc_eq_ok, I5hLib.bind_eq_ok, bind_ok, uncurry_apply_pair, uncurry, ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq, false_and,
        and_false, exists_false, exists_and_left, exists_and_right, exists_eq_left, exists_eq_right,
        Prod.exists, bind_tc_ok, if_true, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true] at $h:ident)
    | (obtain ⟨_, _, $h:ident⟩ := $h)
    | (split at $h:ident))))

theorem ident_test_deny (i : Identity) (hu : IsUser i) (hs : i.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) :
    modify_acc.modify_ident_test i = ok .Deny := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
  unfold modify_acc.modify_ident_test identity_impl.access_scope
  rw [hu]
  cases h : i.scope <;> simp_all

theorem apply_deny (i : Identity) (ra : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved)
    (sa : Slice SyncAgreement) (e : Entry) (r : modify_acc.ModifyResult)
    (hu : IsUser i) (hs : i.scope ≠ .ReadWrite)
    (h : modify_acc.apply_modify_access i ra sa e = ok r) : r = .Deny := by
  unfold modify_acc.apply_modify_access at h
  rw [ident_test_deny i hu hs] at h
  generalize modify_acc.modify_migration_attrs i e = m1 at h
  generalize modify_acc.modify_protected_attrs i e = m2 at h
  cases m1 using Result.cases with
  | vis _ _ => simp [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  | div => simp [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  | ret a1 =>
  cases m2 using Result.cases with
  | vis _ _ => simp [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  | div => simp [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  | ret a2 =>
  cases a1 <;> cases a2 <;>
    simp only [bind_ok, uncurry_apply_pair, Std.bind_assoc, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h <;>
    inv h <;> simp_all

theorem per_entry_false (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (i : Identity)
    (ra : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved) (e : Entry) (ml : Slice Modify) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser i) (hs : i.scope ≠ .ReadWrite)
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation_per_entry ctl i ra e ml = ok b) : b = false := by
  unfold access.modify_allow_operation_per_entry at h
  inv h
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | (have hd := apply_deny _ _ _ _ _ hu hs ‹_›; simp_all)

theorem all_entries_false (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (i : Identity)
    (ra : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved) (es : Slice Entry) (ml : Slice Modify) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser i) (hs : i.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : es.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_all_entries ctl i ra es ml = ok b) : b = false := by
  unfold access.modify_all_entries access.modify_all_entries_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x => x = 0#usize) (fun y => y = false) (fun _ => 0) ?_ _ _ rfl h
  intro x r hx hr
  subst hx
  unfold access.modify_all_entries_loop.body at hr
  inv hr
  all_goals first
    | rfl
    | (have := per_entry_false _ _ _ _ _ _ hu hs ‹_›; simp_all)
    | simp_all [Slice.len]

theorem readonly_cannot_modify (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (hs : me.ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : es.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok b)) :
    b = false := by
  unfold access.modify_allow_operation at h
  inv h
  exact all_entries_false _ _ _ _ _ _ hu hs hne ‹_›

end kanidm_kernel.Solution

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result kanidm_kernel kanidm_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace kanidm_kernel.Solution

theorem readonly_ident_denied (ident : Identity)
    (hu : IsUser ident) (hs : ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) :
    modify_acc.modify_ident_test ident = ok .Deny := by
  obtain ⟨user, huser⟩ := hu
  simp only [modify_acc.modify_ident_test, huser, identity_impl.access_scope, bind_ok]
  cases hscope : ident.scope <;> simp_all

theorem readonly_access_denied (ident : Identity)
    (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved)
    (sync_agreements : Slice SyncAgreement) (entry : Entry)
    (result : modify_acc.ModifyResult)
    (hu : IsUser ident) (hs : ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite)
    (h : modify_acc.apply_modify_access ident related_acp sync_agreements entry = ok result) :
    result = .Deny := by
  have hident := readonly_ident_denied ident hu hs
  obtain ⟨user, huser⟩ := hu
  unfold modify_acc.apply_modify_access at h
  obtain ⟨memberof, hmemberof, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨uuid, huuid, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  simp only [hident, modify_acc.modify_migration_attrs, huser, bind_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨protected_result, hprotected, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  cases protected_result with
  | Deny => simpa using h.symm
  | Ignore => simpa using h.symm
  | Allow pres rem pres_classes rem_classes =>
    simpa using h.symm
  | Constrain pres rem pres_classes rem_classes =>
    simp only [Std.bind_assoc, bind_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨rem_attrs, hrem, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    obtain ⟨pres_attrs, hpres, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    cases pres_classes <;> cases rem_classes <;>
      simp only [bind_ok, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    all_goals
      repeat' (first
        | (solve | simpa using h.symm)
        | (obtain ⟨value, hvalue, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h))

theorem readonly_per_entry_denied (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity)
    (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved) (entry : Entry)
    (modlist : Slice Modify) (decision : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser ident) (hs : ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite)
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation_per_entry ctl ident related_acp entry modlist = ok decision) :
    decision = false := by
  unfold access.modify_allow_operation_per_entry at h
  obtain ⟨disallow, hdisallow, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  cases disallow with
  | true => simpa using h.symm
  | false =>
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
    obtain ⟨pres, hpres, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    obtain ⟨rem, hrem, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    obtain ⟨classes, hclasses, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    cases classes with
    | none => simpa using h.symm
    | some classes =>
      obtain ⟨pres_classes, rem_classes⟩ := classes
      dsimp only at h
      split at h
      · split at h
        · simpa using h.symm
        · obtain ⟨result, hresult, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
          have hdeny := readonly_access_denied ident related_acp
            (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ctl.sync_agreements) entry result hu hs hresult
          subst result
          simpa using h.symm
      · obtain ⟨result, hresult, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
        have hdeny := readonly_access_denied ident related_acp
          (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ctl.sync_agreements) entry result hu hs hresult
        subst result
        simpa using h.symm

theorem readonly_all_entries_denied (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (ident : Identity)
    (related_acp : Slice profiles.AccessControlModifyResolved) (entries : Slice Entry)
    (modlist : Slice Modify) (decision : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser ident) (hs : ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : entries.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_all_entries ctl ident related_acp entries modlist = ok decision) :
    decision = false := by
  have hlen : 0#usize < Slice.len entries := by
    have hpos : 0 < entries.val.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr hne
    scalar_tac
  unfold access.modify_all_entries access.modify_all_entries_loop at h
  rw [loop] at h
  obtain ⟨result, hresult, h⟩ := bind_eq_ok.mp h
  unfold access.modify_all_entries_loop.body at hresult
  simp only [hlen, ↓reduceIte] at hresult
  obtain ⟨entry, hentry, hresult⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hresult
  obtain ⟨allowed, hallowed, hresult⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hresult
  have hdeny := readonly_per_entry_denied ctl ident related_acp entry modlist allowed hu hs hallowed
  subst allowed
  have hdone : result = .done false := by simpa using hresult.symm
  subst result
  simpa using h.symm

theorem readonly_cannot_modify (ctl : AccessControlsInner) (me : ModifyEvent) (es : Slice Entry) (b : Bool)
    (hu : IsUser me.ident) (hs : me.ident.scope ≠ .ReadWrite) (hne : es.val ≠ [])
    (h : access.modify_allow_operation ctl me es = ok (.Ok b)) :
    b = false := by
  unfold access.modify_allow_operation at h
  obtain ⟨related_acp, hrelated, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  obtain ⟨decision, hdecision, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  have hdeny := readonly_all_entries_denied ctl me.ident
    (alloc.vec.Vec.deref related_acp) es (alloc.vec.Vec.deref me.modlist)
    decision hu hs hne hdecision
  simpa [hdeny] using h.symm

end kanidm_kernel.Solution
